{"script":"mkdir -p temp_workspace || exit 1
if [ ! -r /root/matrix.txt ]; then echo "ERROR: /root/matrix.txt missing or not readable" >&2; exit 1; fi
size=$(stat -c%s /root/matrix.txt)
stat /root/matrix.txt > temp_workspace/matrix_meta.txt
echo "Size: $size" >> temp_workspace/matrix_meta.txt
cp /root/matrix.txt temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt
copy_size=$(stat -c%s temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt)
if [ "$size" -ne "$copy_size" ]; then echo "ERROR: size mismatch" >&2; exit 1; fi
charset=$(file -bi temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt | sed -n 's/.*charset=//p')
[ -z "$charset" ] && charset=unknown
echo "Detected charset: $charset" >> temp_workspace/matrix_meta.txt
iconv -f "$charset" -t UTF-8 temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt || tr -d '\r' < temp_workspace/matrix_copy.txt > temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt
echo "Normalized: removed CR characters and converted to UTF-8 (if possible)" >> temp_workspace/matrix_meta.txt
# create preview (first 10 and last 10 lines)
head -n 10 temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt > /tmp/first10.$$ || true
tail -n 10 temp_workspace/matrix_normalized.txt > /tmp/last10.$$ || true
cat /tmp/first10.$$ /tmp/last10.$$ > temp_workspace/matrix_preview.txt
# verify preview matches normalized
cmp -s /tmp/first10.$$ <(head -n 10 temp_workspace/matrix_preview.txt) || { echo "ERROR: preview head mismatch" >&2; rm -f /tmp/first10.$$ /tmp/last10.$$; exit 1; }
cmp -s /tmp/last10.$$ <(tail -n 10 temp_workspace/matrix_preview.txt) || { echo "ERROR: preview tail mismatch" >&2; rm -f /tmp/first10.$$ /tmp/last10.$$; exit 1; }
rm -f /tmp/first10.$$ /tmp/last10.$$
# check artifacts
for f in matrix_copy.txt matrix_normalized.txt matrix_preview.txt matrix_meta.txt; do [ -e temp_workspace/$f ] || { echo "ERROR: Missing $f" >&2; exit 1; } done
# append artifact sizes to meta
echo "Artifacts:" >> temp_workspace/matrix_meta.txt
for f in matrix_copy.txt matrix_normalized.txt matrix_preview.txt matrix_meta.txt; do echo "$f: $(stat -c%s temp_workspace/$f) bytes" >> temp_workspace/matrix_meta.txt; done
lines=$(wc -l < /root/matrix.txt)
echo "Total lines: $lines" >> temp_workspace/matrix_meta.txt
echo "$lines""}
